component.name: VOID Lodestone
component.summary: Play Old School RuneScape and RuneScape 3 with your Jagex accounts

description.p: VOID Lodestone is a fast, open-source launcher for RuneLite, HDOS and RuneScape 3. Sign in with as many Jagex accounts as you like, pick a character and play.

ul.li: Multiple Jagex accounts and characters, each a click away
Old School RuneScape through RuneLite or HDOS
RuneScape 3 with everything it needs included
Clients are downloaded from their official sources and kept up to date
Run several games at once and stop them from the launcher
Custom Java options, client arguments and launch wrappers such as gamemoderun or MangoHud
Seven themes from the VOID suite
No telemetry: game sessions stay in your system keyring

description.p: VOID Lodestone is not affiliated with or endorsed by Jagex. RuneScape and Old School RuneScape are trademarks of Jagex Ltd.

screenshot.caption: Choosing a client and character for Old School

description.p: Saved groups, a client per character, Build & play for plugin developers, a debug switch, a tray icon, crash notices, desktop notifications, playtime and custom backgrounds.
First release: multiple Jagex accounts, RuneLite, HDOS and RuneScape 3, themes and no telemetry.
